headline: Clean little SE windswell with offshore mornings — grab the log.
today: Best conditions of the region are right here early: SE swell to a touch over 2ft at a good angle, offshore NNW-N through morning, then glassing off under a light W by afternoon. It's small and short-period so bring the log or a groveler and work the outgoing tide off the 9:07a high. Nothing serious, but a fun, clean home session — no reason to drive.

daysToWatch.note: Swell nudges to 3ft with a bit more period early, but wind swings SSW cross-on by mid-morning and full S onshore afternoon. Dawn patrol only.
